decision: Memoize validation by typed immutable value while preserving order and invalid-input rejection.

R-repeated-validation.text: compute(records) returns (sku, qty*7) in order. validate rejects empty/nonstring sku and any qty that is not a genuine int from 1 through 9. Validation must still reject invalid repeated records. For N exact repeated valid values, validate at most once per distinct typed value. Different qty for same sku is distinct. Never mutate inputs.

I-repeated-validation.text: Synthetic hot path validated each identical line 200 times. A cache keyed by sku returned the first amount for later quantities. A typed-value collision also confused bool True with int 1.

L-repeated-validation.text: Synthetic hot path validated each identical line 200 times. A cache keyed by sku returned the first amount for later quantities. A typed-value collision also confused bool True with int 1.

T-repeated-validation.text: unseen typed value -> validate -> cache computed result; repeated valid value -> reuse; invalid value -> ValueError.
